verdict.rationale: A government tax filing and payment portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 walls at the front door and the MyFTB/Web Pay host, with no evidence of any built-in assistant that accepts delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
